headline: Centenario Targets 98% Prime Office Occupancy, Plans Expansion in Lima
summary: Peruvian real estate company Centenario projects reaching 98% occupancy across its prime office portfolio and is evaluating construction of a new tower in San Isidro, Lima, for 2027.
why: Centenario is a major commercial real estate developer in Peru. Prime office occupancy rates serve as a key barometer for corporate activity and commercial property values in Lima.

impacts.name: Inversiones Centenario
impacts.why: Higher office occupancy and planned pipeline expansion support rental revenue and asset valuation.
